name: paperzilla-mcp
description: Use Paperzilla projects, feeds, and paper markdown in Codex through the Paperzilla MCP endpoint.

interface.shortDescription: Browse Paperzilla projects and papers in Codex
interface.longDescription: Install Paperzilla MCP in Codex to list projects, browse or search project feeds, inspect paper metadata, and fetch paper markdown. The plugin bundles the Paperzilla MCP endpoint declaration plus a Codex skill that teaches the right tool flow. Configure your Paperzilla MCP API key in Codex MCP config or with the bundled installer.
defaultPrompt: List my Paperzilla projects and open one feed.
Search this Paperzilla project for retrieval evaluation papers.
Fetch this Paperzilla paper as markdown and summarize it.
